svg.title: The Galactic structure prior along four sightlines
svg.desc: The default Galactic prior per unit log distance, from 10 pc to 100 kpc. Per unit log distance, the volume puts the halo peak at 10 to 20 kpc; off the plane, the disks add a second peak at 2 to 4 kpc. Toward the bulge, the bar puts the peak near 8 kpc.
